chapters.title: Turning the Agent Inside Out
chapters.blurb: You start an agent on your laptop. It runs for ten minutes. Then you close the lid to go to a meeting — and the session is just gone.

chapters.title: One Stream, Twenty Projections
chapters.blurb: Chapter one made a promise: everything the agent is lives on one stream. So what actually lands there while an agent works?

chapters.title: Asleep Between Wakes
chapters.blurb: Here is the strangest thing about an Electric agent: between actions, it doesn't exist. No process running, no loop spinning, no memory held. Just the stream, at rest.

chapters.title: The Crash That Didn't Matter
chapters.blurb: An agent is ten minutes into a job. The model is streaming, a web search is mid-flight — and the process running all of it is about to die.
